skills.name: code-review-standards
skills.description: Reviews a diff or branch against the core standards — correctness, security and tenant isolation, error handling, boundaries, tests, naming and size — and reports findings by severity with file:line and a concrete failure. Use when asked to "review my changes", "review this PR", "check this code", "is this ready to merge", or as a self-check before reporting work complete.

skills.name: commit-and-pr
skills.description: Writes Conventional Commits messages, splits work into small reviewable commits and PRs, and structures the PR description. Use when asked to "commit this", "write a commit message", "open a PR", "create a pull request" or "write the PR description".

skills.name: quality-gate
skills.description: Runs the project's single quality gate (npm run quality) over everything the branch changed, reads the output, routes each failure to the right fix, and re-runs until green. Use before reporting any code task complete, before opening a PR, when asked to "run the checks", "check my changes", "is this green", or when a pre-push hook or CI check failed.

skills.name: quality-ratchet
skills.description: Explains and pays down recorded code-health debt — the per-file baseline of oversized files and forbidden patterns that may only go down — and governs when the baseline may be updated. Use when the ratchet step of npm run quality fails, when asked for a "tech debt report", "code health", "what should we clean up" or "where is the worst code", or after a cleanup to lock in lower numbers.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: Read-only reviewer that examines the current branch diff against the project's quality, security, error-handling, boundary, performance, testing and naming standards and returns findings by severity. Use when asked for an independent code review, before opening a PR, or to self-check finished work in a separate context.
